description: One project profile, stored at profiles/<name>.json. Selects sources by id and topic, filters items by keyword and caps the daily digest.

backfill_days.description: Each poll also re-renders this many earlier days' digests from the database, so releases and late changes reach them.

exclude_keywords.description: Lowercase words or phrases; an item matching any of these is dropped even when it matches an include keyword.

guard.description: Injection guard handling. Items at or above hold_at are held from latest.json until released in guard/releases.json; BLOCK is always held from every output.

include_keywords.description: Lowercase words or phrases matched on word boundaries against title and summary. Empty means every item from the selected sources.

outputs.description: Which digest files to write: md (YYYY-MM-DD.md and latest.md) and json (latest.json). report.json is always written.

sources.description: Source ids included regardless of topic.

subtopic_keywords.description: Map of topic/subtopic id to include and exclude keywords. An item matching an include keyword and no exclude keyword is tagged with that subtopic and its topic.

topic_keywords.description: Optional map of topic or topic/subtopic id to the keywords that tag an item with it.

topics.description: topic or topic/subtopic ids from schema/topics.json; every enabled source carrying one of them is included.

window_days.description: Only items published (or, when undated, first seen) within this many days before the digest day are eligible.

title: Project profile
